Mhedi]] → [[Vow of Strength]] ([[Mhedi's Vow]]) ==Notes== *This is one of the few places in Kourna where you may obtain [[Lightbringer rank|Lightbringer]] [[bounty|bounties]]. *A [[Preserved Red Iris Flower]] can be found in a chest in the southern Corsair area. *There are four bosses close to each other in the southern Corsair area; use caution when approaching them, especially in [[hard mode]]. **In hard mode, the [[Corsair Grappler]]s in this area can instantly [[wipe]] an entire party as they deal extremely high [[area of effect]] [[physical damage]]. *These quests affect the spawns in this area: **[[A Fool's Luck]] **[[A Message for Janeera]] **[[A Question of Morality]] **[[Koss Goes Recruiting]] **[[The Foolhardy Father]] *Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 2.6% to the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title track. *{{Vanquisher|count = 177|low = 153|high = 201}} **You can avoid killing 3-5 of the hidden [[Mandragor]] groups by first clearing the western area, crossing the river using the southern route, and defeating a pride of low-level lions nearby. *The lions in this region are all located in the east, across the bridge. They're all in one pack, and they all start out as hostile; they are however still charmable. ==Trivia== *The map provided with the [[Collector's Edition]] of [[Guild Wars Nightfall]] names this area as the "Barbarous Coast". The [[W:Barbary Coast|Barbary Coast]], or Barbary, was the term used by Europeans from the 16th until the 19th century to refer to the middle and western coastal regions of North Africa. The [[W:Barbary pirate|barbary pirates]] of north Africa are sometimes called "Turkish corsairs" or "Ottoman corsairs". *There is an exit portal behind a permanently-closed gate in the north-east of the map that cannot be accessed and does not lead to another zone, but could sometimes be seen by players from a far enough distance that the gate model had not loaded. {{Explorable areas in Kourna}} [[Category:Has Lightbringer bounties]] [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Barbarenküste]]
